The '''Tol Amn system''' lay within the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] portion of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Oktos Route]] that connected it both to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] and the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route known as the [[Trax Tube/Legends|Trax Tube]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Tol Amn system contained a planet of [[Tol Amn|the same name]] that was used by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] [[Agriworld/Legends|production]], with serfs of various species being employed to that end.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tol Amn system was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square R-11.<ref name="TEA" />
